entries.translation_en:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah, O He who thrust out the tongue of the morning with the speech of its dawn,
drove on the pieces of the dark night through the depths of its stammering darkness,
perfected the making of the revolving sphere in the measures of its splendour,
and caused the light of the sun to shine brightly with the light of its blazing!
O He who pointed to His own Essence by His Essence,
who is exalted above likeness to His creatures,
and who is far above conformity with their qualities!
O He who is nearer than the promptings of conjecture,
farther than the glances of eyes,
and who knew what would be before it came to be!
O He who laid me to sleep in the cradle of His security and His safety,
awakened me to what He granted me of His favours and His goodness,
and held back the hands of evil from me by His hand and His power!
Bless, O Allah, the guide towards You in the darkest night,
the one who holds, among Your means, to the rope of the longest honour,
the one of pure lineage at the peak of the mightiest summit,
firm of foot upon its slippery slopes in the earliest age —
and (bless) his Household, the good, the chosen, the righteous.
Open for us, O Allah, the leaves of the morning's door with the keys of mercy and success.
Clothe me, O Allah, with the finest robes of guidance and righteousness.
Plant, O Allah, by Your greatness, in the soil of my heart the springs of humility.
Make flow, O Allah, at (the thought of) Your awe, from the corners of my eyes, streams of tears.
Discipline, O Allah, the rashness of my folly with the reins of contentment.
My God, if Your mercy does not begin with me through goodly success,
then who is the guide who will take me to You along the clear path?
And if Your gentleness surrenders me to the leader of hope and desire,
then who will pardon my stumbles from the pitfalls of caprice?
And if Your help abandons me in the battle against the self and Satan,
then Your abandonment has left me to hardship and deprivation.
My God, do You see me? I have come to You only from the side of hopes;
or have I clung to the ends of Your ropes except when my sins had distanced me from the abode of union?
Wretched is the mount that my soul has ridden of its caprice!
Woe to it, for what its conjectures and desires have embellished for it!
And ruin to it, for its audacity against its Master and Lord!
My God, I have knocked at the door of Your mercy with the hand of my hope;
I have fled to You, taking refuge from the excess of my desires;
and I have hung, upon the ends of Your ropes, the fingers of my allegiance.
So pardon, O Allah, the slips and errors that I have committed,
and lift me up from the fall of my garment (of sin);
for You are my Master, my Lord, my reliance and my hope,
and You are the goal of my quest and my desire, in my final return and my dwelling.
My God, how could You drive away a destitute one who has sought refuge with You, fleeing from sins?
How could You disappoint a seeker of guidance who has hurried to Your court?
How could You turn back a thirsty one who came down to Your pools to drink?
Never! For Your pools are filled to the brim in the hardship of drought,
and Your door is open to seeking and to entering,
and You are the goal of the one who is asked and the utmost of the one who is hoped in.
My God, these are the reins of my soul: I have bound them with the cord of Your will;
and these are the burdens of my sins: I have warded them off with Your pardon and Your mercy;
and these are my misleading desires: I have entrusted them to the court of Your kindness and Your gentleness.
So make, O Allah, this morning of mine descend upon me with the light of guidance,
with safety in religion and in this world,
and make my evening a shield against the plot of enemies
and a protection against the ruinous ends of caprice.
Indeed, You are able to do what You will:
You give the kingdom to whom You will,
and You strip the kingdom from whom You will;
You exalt whom You will,
and You abase whom You will;
in Your hand is all good;
indeed, You have power over all things.
You make the night pass into the day,
and You make the day pass into the night;
You bring the living out of the dead,
and You bring the dead out of the living;
and You provide for whom You will, without measure.
There is no god but You. Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You!
Who is it that knows Your worth and does not fear You?
And who is it that knows what You are, and does not stand in awe of You?
By Your power You have joined together the separate parts,
by Your gentleness You have split open the dawn,
by Your generosity You have lit up the depths of the darkness,
You have made waters gush from the hard, deaf rocks, sweet and bitter,
and You have sent down from the rain-clouds water pouring forth,
and You have made the sun and the moon for creation a blazing lamp,
without, in what You originated, suffering fatigue or needing treatment.
O He who is alone in might and permanence,
and who has subdued His servants with death and annihilation:
bless Muhammad and his Household, the God-fearing;
hear my call and answer my prayer;
realise, by Your grace, my hope and my expectation.
O best of those who are called upon to remove harm,
and the hoped-in one in every hardship and ease:
before You I have laid down my need, so do not turn me back, disappointed, from Your splendid gifts.
O Generous One, O Generous One, O Generous One — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
And may Allah bless the best of His creation, Muhammad, and all of his Household.
My God, my heart is veiled, my soul is defective, my intellect is overpowered, my caprice is victorious, my obedience is little, my disobedience is much, and my tongue confesses the sins — so what is my recourse, O Concealer of faults, O Knower of the unseen, O Remover of sorrows? Forgive all of my sins, by the sanctity of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad. O Forgiver, O Forgiver, O Forgiver — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
entries.note_en: The morning supplication of Imam Ali (a.s.).

اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مرة) — اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مرة) — سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٣٣ مرة)

لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَ عِزِّ جَلَالِهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ كُلَّمَا
حَمِدَ اللّٰهَ شَى ءٌ وَ كَمَا يُحِبُّ اللّٰهُ اَنْ يُحْمَدَ وَ كَما
هُوَ اَهْلُهُ وَ كَما يَنْبَغىِ لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَ عِزِّ جَلَالِهِ
وَ لَا اِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ كُلَّمَا هَلَّلَ اللّٰهَ شَيْءٌ وَ
كَمَا يُحِبُّ اللّٰهُ اَنْ يُهَلَّلَ وَ كَمَا هُوَ اَهْلُهُ وَ كَمَا
يَنْبَغِى لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَ عِزِّ جَلَالِهِ.
وَ اللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كُلَّمَا كَبَّرَ اللّٰهَ شَيْ ءٌ وَ كَمَا يُحِبُّ
اللّٰهُ اَنْ يُكَبَّرَ وَ كَمَا هُوَ اَهْلُهُ وَ كَمَا يَنْبَغِى
لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَ عِزِّ جَلَالِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ
لِلّهِ وَ لَا اِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَ اللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ عَلٰى كُلِّ
نِعْمَةٍ اَنْعَمَ بِهَا عَلَىَّ وَ عَلٰى كُلِّ اَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
مِمَّنْ كَانَ اَوْ يَكُونُ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ اَللّٰهُمَّ
اِنِّى اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ
اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا اَرْجُوْ وَ خَيْرِ مَا لَا اَرْجُوْ وَ
اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اَحْذَرُ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَا اَحْذَرُ.
سُبْحٰانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ وَ سَلٰامٌ
عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمينَ
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اجْعَلْ لِىْ
مِنْ اَمْرِىْ فَرَجاً وَ مَخْرَجاً وَ ارْزُقْنِىْ مِنْ حَيْثُ
اَحْتَسِبُ وَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا اَحْتَسِبُ
يَا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ ارْحَمْنِىْ وَ اَجِرْنِىْ مِنَ النّٰارِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنّى اَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُونِ الْمَخْزُونِ
الطَّاهِرِ الطُّهْرِ الْمُبَارَكِ وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظيْمِ
وَ سُلْطَانِكَ الْقَدِيْمِ يَا وَاهِبَ الْعَطَايَا وَ يَا مُطْلِقَ
الْاُسَارَى وَ يَا فَكَّاكَ الرِّقَابِ مِنَ النّٰارِ اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ
تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُعْتِقَ
رَقَبَتِىْ مِنَ النّٰارِ وَ اَنْ تُخْرِجَنِىْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
سَالِماً وَ [اَنْ] تُدْخِلَنِى الْجَنَّةَ آمِناً وَ اَنْ تَجْعَلَ
دُعاَئِىْ اَوَّلَهُ فَلَاحاً وَ اَوْسَطَهُ نَجَاحاً وَ آخِرَهُ
صَلَاحاً اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ
يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ سَمْعٌ عَنْ سَمْعٍ وَ يَا مَنْ لَا
يُغَلِّطُهُ السَّائِلُوْنَ وَ يَا مَنْ لَايُبْرِمُهُ اِلْحاحُ
المُلِحِّينَ اَذِقْنِىْ بَرْدَ عَفْوِكَ وَ حَلَاوَةَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ
مَغْفِرَتِكَ
اِلٰهِىْ هٰذِهِ صَلَوٰتِىْ صَلَّيْتُهَا لَا لِحَاجَةٍ مِنْكَ
اِلَيْهَا وَ لَا رَغْبَةٍ مِنْكَ فِيْهَا إِلَّا تَعْظِيْماً وَ
طَاعَةً وَاِجَابَةً لَكَ اِلٰى مَا اَمَرْتَنِىْ بِهِ اِلٰهِىْ اِنْ
كَانَ فِيْهَا خَلَلٌ اَوْ نَقْصٌ مِنْ رُكُوْعِهَا اَوْ سُجُوْدِهَا
فَلَا تُؤَ اخِذْنِى وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلَىَّ بِالْقَبُوْلِ وَ
الْغُفْرَانِ .
سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَايَعْتَدِىْ عَلٰى اَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ
لَا يَاْخُذُ اَهْلَ الْاَرْضِ بِاَلْوَانِ الْعَذَابِ سُبْحَانَ
الرَّؤُفِ الرَّحِيْمِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِىْ فِى قَلْبِى نُوْراً
وَ بَصَراً وَ فَهْماً وَ عِلْماً اِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَديرٌ .
اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِىْ وَ دِيْنِى وَ اَهْلِى وَ مَالِىْ وَ وَلَدِىْ وَ
اِخْوَانِى فىِ دِيْنِى وَ مَا رَزَقَنِى رَبِّى وَ خَوَاتِيْمَ
عَمَلِى وَ مَنْ يَعْنِيْنِى اَمْرُهُ بِاللّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْاَحَدِ
الصَّمَدِ الَّذِىْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَ لَمْ يُولَدْ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ
كُفُواً اَحَدٌ وَ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَ مِنْ
شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَبَ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثٰاتِ فِى الْعُقَدِ
وَ مِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ وَ بِرَبِّ النّٰاسِ مَلِكِ
النّٰاسِ اِلٰهِ النّٰاسِ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنّٰاسِ الَّذِىْ
يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُوْرِ النّٰاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النّٰاسِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ مَغْفِرَتَكَ اَرْجِى مِنْ عَمَلِى وَ اِنَّ
رَحْمَتَكَ اَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذَنْبِى اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَ ذَنْبِى
عِنْدَكَ عَظِيْماً فَعَفْوُكَ اَعْظَمُ مِنْ ذَنْبِىْ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ
لَمْ اَكُنْ اَهْلاً اَنْ اَبْلُغَ رَحْمَتَكَ فَرَحْمَتُكَ اَهْلٌ اَنْ
تَبْلُغَنِى وَ تَسَعَنِى لِاَنَّهَا وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَااَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَ مِنْكَ السَّلَامُ وَ لَكَ السَّلَامُ
وَ اِلَيْكَ يَعُودُ السَّلَامُ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ
عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ وَ سَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَ الْحَمْدُ
لِلّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ
وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْاَئِمَّةِ
الْهَادِيْنَ الْمَهْدِيِّينَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى جَمِيْعِ اَنْبِياَءِ
اللّٰهِ وَ رُسُلِهِ وَ مَلاَئِكَتِهِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلٰى
عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِينَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى عَلِىٍّ اَمِيْرِ
الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ سَيِّدَىْ
شَبابِ اَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى عَلِىِّ بْنِ
الْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ
عَلِىٍّ بَاقِرِ عِلْمِ النَّبِيّينَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى جَعْفَرِ بْنِ
مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّادِقِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى مُوْسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
الْكَاظِمِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى عَلِىِّ بْنِ مُوْسَىٰ الرِّضَا
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِىٍّ الْجَوَادِ اَلسَّلَامُ
عَلٰى عَلِىٍّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَادِىْ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْحَسَنِ
بْنِ عَلِي الزَّكِىِّ الْعَسْكَرِىِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْحُجَّةِ بْنِ
الْحَسَنِ الْقَائِمِ الْمَهْدِىِّ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِمْ
اَجْمَعِينَ.
رَضِيْتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبّاً وبِالْاِسْلَامِ دِيْناً وَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ
صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وآلِهِ نَبِيّاً وَ بِعَلِىٍّ اِمَاماً وَ
بِالْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ عَلِىٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَ
مُوسَىٰ وَ عَلِىٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِىٍّ وَ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْخَلَفِ
الصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ اَئِمَّةً وَ سَادَةً وَ قَادَةً
بِهِمْ اَتَوَلّٰى وَ مِنْ اَعْدَائِهِمْ اَتَبَرَّءُ
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّى اَسْئَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَ
الْمُعَافَاةَ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ .
entries.translation_en:
(Say three times, raising the hands: Allah is Great.) Then say the Tasbihat al-Zahra: Allah is Great (34 times), all praise belongs to Allah (33 times), glory be to Allah (33 times). Then:
There is no god but Allah, the one God, and we submit to Him. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him, sincere in religion towards Him, however much the polytheists may hate it. There is no god but Allah, our Lord and the Lord of our forefathers, the first generations. There is no god but Allah — alone, alone, alone. He has fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, strengthened His army, and defeated the confederates, alone. To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs the praise; He gives life and He gives death, and He gives death and He gives life; and He is Living and does not die; in His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance.
O Allah, guide me from Your presence, pour upon me from Your grace, spread over me from Your mercy, and send down upon me from Your blessings. Glory be to You; there is no god but You; forgive me all of my sins, all of them together, for none forgives the sins — all of them together — but You. O Allah, I ask You for every good that Your knowledge encompasses, and I seek refuge in You from every evil that Your knowledge encompasses.
O Allah, I ask You for Your well-being in all of my affairs, and I seek refuge in You from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter. I seek refuge in Your noble Face, in Your glory that cannot be resisted, and in Your power from which nothing can escape — from the evil of this world and the Hereafter, from the evil of all pains, and from the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold. Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty. I have relied upon the Living One who does not die; and all praise belongs to Allah, who has not taken a child, has no partner in the kingdom, and has no protector out of lowliness — and magnify Him with all magnification.
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner to Him — one God, Single, One, Eternal Refuge, who has taken neither a consort nor a child.
Glory be to Allah — as often as anything has glorified Allah, as Allah loves to be glorified, as He is worthy of, and as befits the nobility of His Face and the might of His glory. And all praise belongs to Allah — as often as anything has praised Allah, as Allah loves to be praised, as He is worthy of, and as befits the nobility of His Face and the might of His glory. And there is no god but Allah — as often as anything has declared Allah's oneness, as Allah loves to be declared One, as He is worthy of, and as befits the nobility of His Face and the might of His glory. And Allah is Great — as often as anything has magnified Allah, as Allah loves to be magnified, as He is worthy of, and as befits the nobility of His Face and the might of His glory. Glory be to Allah, all praise belongs to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is Great — for every blessing He has bestowed upon me and upon every one of His creatures, whoever was and whoever will be, until the Day of Resurrection.
O Allah, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad; and I ask You for the best of what I hope for and the best of what I do not hope for; and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I guard against and from the evil of what I do not guard against.
(Recite here: Surah al-Fatiha, Ayat al-Kursi (2:255-257), the Verses of Witness (3:18-19), the Verses of Sovereignty (3:26-27), the Verses of Subjugation (7:54-56), and 37:180-183 — all are in this app's Quran section.)
Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe; and peace be upon the messengers; and all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. (37:180-182)
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and appoint for me, in my affair, relief and a way out, and provide for me from where I expect and from where I do not expect.
O Lord of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and hasten the relief of the Household of Muhammad.
O Possessor of Majesty and Honour, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, have mercy on me, and rescue me from the Fire.
O Allah, I ask You by Your hidden, stored, pure, purifying, blessed Name; and I ask You by Your mighty Name and Your eternal sovereignty. O Giver of gifts, O Releaser of captives, O Free-er of necks from the Fire: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, to free my neck from the Fire, to bring me out of this world in safety, to admit me into Paradise in security, and to make the beginning of my prayer prosperity, its middle success, and its end righteousness. Indeed, You are the Knower of the unseen.
O He whom no hearing distracts from another hearing; O He whom the askers do not confuse; O He who is not wearied by the persistence of the persistent: let me taste the coolness of Your pardon and the sweetness of Your mercy and Your forgiveness.
My God, this is my prayer; I have prayed it — not because You have any need of it, nor any desire for it — but in magnification, obedience, and answer to what You commanded me. My God, if there was in it any flaw or deficiency, in its bowing or its prostration, do not take me to task for it; bestow on me acceptance and forgiveness.
Glory be to the One who does not transgress against the people of His kingdom; glory be to the One who does not seize the people of the earth with kinds of punishment; glory be to the All-Gentle, the All-Merciful. O Allah, place in my heart light, sight, understanding and knowledge; indeed, You have power over all things.
I commend to protection — my soul, my religion, my family, my wealth, my children, my brothers in my religion, what my Lord has provided me, the endings of my deeds, and everyone whose affair concerns me — to Allah, the One, the Single, the Eternal Refuge, who does not beget and was not begotten, and to whom there is no equal; (and I seek protection) by the Lord of the Daybreak (Surah al-Falaq) from the evil of what He created, from the evil of the darkness when it settles, from the evil of the blowers on knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies; and by the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind (Surah al-Nas), from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.
O Allah, Your forgiveness is more hoped-for than my own deeds, and Your mercy is wider than my sin. O Allah, if my sin is great in Your sight, Your pardon is greater than my sin. O Allah, if I am not worthy to reach Your mercy, Your mercy is worthy to reach me and to encompass me, because it encompasses all things — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace, and to You belongs peace, and to You peace returns. Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe; and peace be upon the messengers; and all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon the rightly guided Imams. Peace be upon all the prophets of Allah, His messengers and His angels. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. Peace be upon Ali, Commander of the Faithful. Peace be upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two masters of the youth of all the people of Paradise. Peace be upon Ali ibn al-Husayn, Zayn al-Abidin. Peace be upon Muhammad ibn Ali, the splitter of the knowledge of the prophets. Peace be upon Ja'far ibn Muhammad, the Truthful. Peace be upon Musa ibn Ja'far, the one who restrains (his anger). Peace be upon Ali ibn Musa, the Well-Pleased. Peace be upon Muhammad ibn Ali, the Generous. Peace be upon Ali ibn Muhammad, the Guide. Peace be upon al-Hasan ibn Ali, the Pure, al-Askari. Peace be upon al-Hujjah ibn al-Hasan, the Rising One, al-Mahdi — may the blessings of Allah be upon them all.
I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, with Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, as prophet, with Ali as Imam, and with al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Ali, Muhammad, Ja'far, Musa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan and the righteous Successor, peace be upon them, as Imams, masters and leaders; through them I show allegiance, and from their enemies I turn away.
O Allah, I ask You for pardon, well-being, and lasting well-being in this world and in the Hereafter.
entries.note_en: After the closing salam of any obligatory prayer: say Allahu Akbar three times raising the hands, then Tasbihat al-Zahra (below), then these common litanies. The Quran passages named inside (al-Fatiha; Ayat al-Kursi 2:255-257; 3:18-19; 3:26-27; 7:54-56; 37:180-183) are all in this app's Quran section.

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مرة) — اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مرة) — سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٣٣ مرة)
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ علَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
وَٱهْدِنِي لِمَا ٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ
إِنَّكَ تَهْدي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
اَلْأَوْصِيَاءِ ٱلرَّاضِينَ ٱلْمَرْضِيِّينَ
بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ
وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِمْ بِأَفْضَلِ بَرَكَاتِكَ
وَٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِمْ
وَعَلىٰ أَرْوَاحِهِمْ وَ أَجْسَادِهِمْ
وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
اللّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي عَلى ما أَحْيَيْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طالِبٍ
وَأَمِتْنِي عَلى ما ماتَ عَلَيْهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طالِبٍ عليه السلام
أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
أَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلْعَافِيَةَ
أَسْتَجِيرُ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
وَ أَسْأَلُهُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ
أَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلْحُورَ ٱلْعِينَ
لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبينُ
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّه
ِوَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِوَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُوَٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ كَانَ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد عَلَيْكَ
صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
وَٱجْعَلِ ٱلنُّورَ فِي بَصَرِي
وَٱلْبَصِيرَةَ فِي دِينِي
وَٱلْيَقِينَ فِي قَلْبِي
وَٱلإِخْلاَصَ فِي عَمَلِي
وَٱلسَّلاَمَةَ فِي نَفْسِي
وَٱلسَّعَةَ فِي رِزْقِي
وَٱلشُّكْرَ لَكَ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي
يا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ .
يا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَأَعْتِقْ رَقَبَتي مِنَ النَّارِ.
يَا عَزِيْزُ.
سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظيْمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ وَاَسْئَلُهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ۔
اِسْتَمْسَكْتُ بِعُرْوَةِ اللهِ الْوُثْقٰى الَّتِيْ لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا وَ اسْتَعْصَمْتُ بِحَبْلِ اللهِ الْمَتِيْنِ.
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ فَوْرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَ الْعَجَمِ وَ اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شَرِّ شَيَاطِيْنِ الْاِنْسِ وَ الْجِنِّ. ‏
تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ طَلَبْتُ حَاجَتِيْ مِنَ اللهِ حَسْبِيَ اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَ اِنْ كَانَتْ قَطِيْعَۃً
فَاِنِّيْ مَا اَرَدْتُ بِهٖ قَطِيْعَۃً وَ لَا اَقُوْلُ لَكَ الْعُتْبٰي
لَا اَعُوْدُ بِمَا اَعْلَمُهٗ مِنْ خَلَّتِيْ وَ لَا اسْتَتِمُّ التَّوْبَۃَ لِمَا اَعْلَمُهٗ مِنْ ضَعُفِيْ
وَ قَدْ جِئْتُ اَطْلُبُ عَفْوَكَ وَ وَسِيْلَتِيْ اِلَيْكَ كَرَمُكَ
فَصَلِّ عَلٰي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَكْرِمْنِيْ بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
أَسْتَمْسَكُ بِعُرْوَةِ اللَّهِ الْوُثْقَى ،
الَّتِي لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا ،
وَاعْتَصَمْتُ بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ الْمَتِينِ ،
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ شَيَاطِينِ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ ،
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ ،
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ ،
تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ،
أَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ،
طَلَبْتُ حَاجَتِي مِنَ اللَّهِ ،
لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَلْبِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي بَصَرِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي سَمْعِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي لِسَانِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي بَشَرِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي شَعْرِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي لَحْمِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي دَمِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي عِظَامِي ،
وَنُوراً فِي عَصَبِي ،
وَنُوراً بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ ،
وَنُوراً مِنْ خَلْفِي ،
وَنُوراً عَنْ يَمِينِي ،
وَنُوراً عَنْ شِمَالِي ،
وَنُوراً مِنْ فَوْقِي ،
وَنُوراً مِنْ تَحْتِي ،
اَللّهُمَّ أَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً.
إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ،
وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ ﴿١٩٠﴾ ،
الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا ،
وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ ،
وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ،
رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا ،
سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ﴿١٩١﴾ ،
رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ،
وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ﴿١٩٢﴾ ،
رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ ،
فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا ،
وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا ،
وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٣﴾ ،
رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ ،
وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ،
إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ ﴿١٩٤﴾.
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الصَّبَاحِ ،
فَالِقِ الْإِصْبَاحِ ،
وَجَاعِلِ اللَّيْلِ سَكَناً ،
وَالشَّمْسِ وَالْقَمَرِ حُسْبَاناً.
اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَ يَوْمِي هَذَا صَلَاحاً ،
وَأَوْسَطَهُ نَجَاحاً ،
وَآخِرَهُ فَلَاحاً.
اَللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ أَصْبَحَ وَحَاجَتُهُ ،
وَطَلِبَتُهُ إِلَى مَخْلُوقٍ ،
فَإِنَّ حَاجَتِي وَطَلِبَتِي إِلَيْكَ وَحْدَكَ ،
لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
يَا فَتَّاحُ
لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاََّ بِٱللَّهِ
تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيراً
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ
وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّد وآلِهِ
﴿وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصيرٌ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
فَوَقَاهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا﴾
﴿لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلغَمِّ
وَكَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي ٱلْمُؤْمِنينَ﴾
﴿حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
فَٱنَقَلَبُوٱ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ
لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ﴾
مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ
لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ مَا شَاءَ ٱلنَّاسُ
مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنْ كَرِهَ ٱلنَّاسُ
حَسْبِيَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْبُوبِينَ
حَسْبِيَ ٱلْخَالِقُ مِنَ ٱلْمَخْلُوقِينَ
حَسْبِيَ ٱلرَّازِقُ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْزُوقِينَ
حَسْبِيَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
حَسْبِي مَنْ هُوَ حَسْبِي
حَسْبِي مَنْ لَمْ يَزَلْ حَسْبِي
حَسْبِي مَنْ كَانَ مُذْ كُنْتُ لَمْ يَزَلْ حَسْبِي
﴿حَسْبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ
وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ﴾
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ‏ عَرَّفَنِيْ‏ نَفْسَهٗ‏ وَ لَمْ يَتْرُكْنِيْ عَمْيَانَ الْقَلْبِ
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَنِيْ مِنْ اُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِه
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ رِزْقِيْ فِيْ يَدَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْ رِزْقِيْ فِي اَيْدِيْ النَّاسِ
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ سَتَرَ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَ عُيُوْبِيْ وَ لَمْ يَفْضَحْنِيْ بَيْنَ الْخَلَايِقِ.
لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِيْ وَ يُمِيْتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَ هُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ.
أَصْبَحْتُ ٱللَّهُمَّ مُعْتَصِماً بِذِمَامِكَ ٱلْمَنِيعِ
ٱلَّذِي لاَ يُطَاوَلُ وَلاَ يُحَاوَلُ
مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ غَاشِمٍ وَطَارِقٍ
مِنْ سَائِرِ مَنْ خَلَقْتَ وَمَا خَلَقْتَ
مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ٱلصَّامِتِ وَٱلنَّاطِقِ
في جُنَّةٍ مِنْ كُلِّ مَخُوفٍ
بِلِبَاسٍ سَابِغَةٍ
وَلاَءِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ
مُحْتَجِباً مِنْ كُلِّ قَاصِدٍ لِي إِلىٰ أَذِيَّةٍ
بِجِدَارٍ حَصِينٍ
ٱلإِخْلاَصِ فِي ٱلإِعْتِرَافِ بِحَقِّهِمْ
وَٱلتَّمَسُّكِ بَحَبْلِهِمْ
مُوقِناً أَنَّ ٱلْحَقَّ لَهُمْ وَمَعَهُمْ
وَفيهِمْ وَبِهِمْ
أُوَالِي مَنْ وَالَوْٱ
وَأُجَانِبُ مَنْ جَانَبُوٱ
فَأَعِذْنِي اَللَّهُمَّ بِهِمْ
مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَا أَتَّقيهِ يَا عَظِيمُ
حَجَزْتُ ٱلأَعَادِيَ عَنِّي بِبَدِيعِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ
وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْديهِمِ سَدّاً
وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدّاً
فَأَغْشَيْنَاهُمْ فَهُمْ لاَ يُبْصِرُونَ
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْلِحْ لِيْ دِيْنِيَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهٗ لِيْ عِصْمَةً.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِيْ جَعَلْتَ فِيْهَا مَعَاشِيْ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْلِحْ لِيْ آخِرَتِيَ الَّتِيْ جَعَلْتَ اِلَيْهَا مَرْجَعِيْ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَ اَعُوْذُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ نِقْمَتِكَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا اَعْطَيْتَ وَ لَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَ لَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِيْ بِسَمْعِيْ وَ بَصَرِيْ وَ اجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَيْنِ مِنِّيْ وَ اَرِنِيْ ثَارِيْ مِنْ عَدُوِّيْ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْحُزْنِ وَ الْعَجْزِ وَ الْكَسَلِ وَ الْبُخْلِ وَ الْجُبْنِ وَ ضَلْعِ الدَّيْنِ وَ غَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ وَ بَوَارِ الْاَيَّمِ وَ الْغَفْلَةِ وَ الذِّلَّةِ وَ الْقَسْوَةِ وَ الْعَيْلَةِ وَ الْمَسْكَنَةِ
وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ لَا تَدْمَعُ وَ مِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ وَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ لَا تَنْفَعُ (تُرْفَعُ)
وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنِ امْرَاَةٍ تُشَيِّبُنِيْ قَبْلَ اَوَانَ مَشِيْبِيْ وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيَّ رِبًّا وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ مَالٍ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيَّ عَذَابًا وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ صَاحِبِ خَدِيْعَةٍ اِنْ رَاَى حَسَنَةٍ دَفَنَهَا وَ اِنْ رَاَىْ سَيِّئَةً اَفْشَاهَا.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِفَاجِرٍ عَلَيَّ (عِنْدِيْ) يَدًا وَ لَا مِنَّةً.‏
اََللَّهُمَّ وَ كُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ فِيْ خَلْقِكَ وَ لِيَا وَ حَافِظًا وَ قَائِدًا وَ نَاصِرًا حَتّيٰ تُسْكِنَهُ اَرْضَكَ طَوْعًا وَ تُمَتِّعَهُ مِنْهَا (فِيْهِا) طَوِيْلًا،
وَ تَجْعَلَهُ وَ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ فِيْهِا اْلاَئِمَّةَ الْوَارِثِيْنَ،
وَ اجْمَعْ لَهُ شَمْلَهُ،
وَ اَكْمِلْ لَهُ اَمْرَهُ،
وَ اَصْلِحْ لَهُ رَعِيَّتَهُ،
وَ ثَبِّتْ رُكْنَهُ،
وَ اَفْرِغِ الصَّبْرَ مِنْكَ عَلَيْهِ حَتّيٰ يَنْتَقِمَ،
فِيْشْتَفِيْ وَ يَشْفِيْ حَزَازَاتِ قُلُوْبٍ نَغِلَةٍ وَ حَرَارَاتِ صُدُرٍ وَ غِرَةٍ وَ حَسَرَاتِ اَنْفُسٍ تَرِحَةٍ،
مَنْ دِمَاءٍ مَسْفُوكَةٍ وَ اَرْحَامٍ مَقْطُوْعَةٍ وَ طَاعَةٍ مَجْهُوْلَةٍ،
قَدْ اَحْسَنْتَ اِلَيْهِ الْبَلاَءَ وَ وَ سَّعْتَ عَلَيْهِ اْلآلاَءَ وَ اَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ النَّعْمَاءَ فِيْ حُسْنِ الْحِفْظِ مِنْكَ لَهُ،
اََللَّهُمَّ اكْفِهِ هَوْلَ عَدُوِّهِ،
وَ اَنْسِهِمْ ذِكْرَهُ،
وَ اَرِدْ مَنْ اَرَادَهُ وَ كِدْ مَنْ كَادَهُ،
وَ امْكُرْ بِمَنْ مَكَرَ بِهِ وَ اجْعَلْ دَائِرَةَ السَّوْءِ عَلَيْهِمْ...
اََللَّهُمََّّ صَلِّ عَليٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ.
اٰمَنْتُ بِاللهِ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَ كَفَرْتُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَ الطَّاغُوْتِ،وَ اٰمَنْتُ بِسِرِّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَانِيَتِهِمْ،وَ ظَاهِرِهِمْ وَ بَاطِنِهِمْ وَ اَوَّلِهِمْ وَ اٰخِرِهِمْ۔
أَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ اكْتُبَا رَحِمَكُمَا اللَّهُ
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرّحمنِ الرَّحِيمِ أَمْسَيْتُ وَ أَصْبَحْتُ بِاللَّهِ مُؤْمِناً عَلَى دِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلّى اللهُ عليه وآله) وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ عَلَى دِينِ عَلِيٍّ (عليه السَّلامُ) وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ عَلَى دِينِ فَاطِمَةَ (عليها السَّلامُ) وَ سُنَّتِهَا وَ عَلَى دِينِ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ صَلَواتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسُنَّتِهِمْ
آمَنْتُ بِسِرِّهِمْ وَعَلَانِيَتِهِمْ وَبِغَيْبِهِمْ وَشَهَادَتِهِمْ وَأَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ فِي لَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ وَيَوْمِي هَذَا مِمَّا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَعَلِيٌّ وَفَاطِمَةُ وَالْأَوْصِيَاءُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَرْغَبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ فِيمَا رَغِبُوا فِيهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
يَا مَاجِدُ يَا جَوَادُ يَا حَيّاً حِينَ لَا حَيَّ
يَا فَرْدُ يَا مُنْفَرِداً بِالْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ
يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْتَبِهُ عَلَيْهِ الْأَصْوَاتُ
يَا مَنْ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ اللُّغَاتُ
يَا مَنْ‏ يَعْلَمُ ما تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثى‏
وما تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحامُ وما تَزْدادُ
يَا مَنْ‏ يَعْلَمُ خائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وما تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ
يَا مَنْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِسَرِيرَتِي مِنِّي بِهَا
يَا مَالِكَ الْأَشْيَاءِ قَبْلَ تَكْوِينِهَا
أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُونِ الْمَخْزُونِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ
الَّذِي هُوَ نُورٌ مِنْ نُورٍ
وأَسْأَلُكَ بِنُورِكَ السَّاطِعِ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ
وسُلْطَانِكَ الْغَالِبِ ومُلْكِكَ الْقَاهِرِ لِمَنْ دُونَكَ
وبِقُدْرَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا تُذِلُّ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
وبِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
وأَنْ تُعِيذَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ مَضَلَّاتِ الْفِتَنِ
ومِنْ شَرِّ جَمِيعِ مَا يَخَافُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ‏ الدُّعَاءِ وأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ‏
اِلٰهِيْ هٰذِهٖ صَلَاتِيْ صَلَّيْتُهَا لَا لِحَاجَۃٍ مِنْكَ اِلَيْهَا، وَ لَا رَغْبَۃٍ مِنْكَ فِيْهَا اِلَّا تَعْظِيْمًا وَ طَاعَۃً وَ اِجَابَۃً لَكَ اِلٰي مَا اَمَرْتَنِيْ بِهٖ. اِلٰهِيْ اِنْ كَانَ فِيْهَا خَلَلٌ اَوْ نَقْصٌ مِنْ رُكُوْعِهَا اَوْ سُجُوْدِهَا، فَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنِيْ وَ تَفَضَّلَ عَلَيَّ بِالْقُبُوْلِ وَ الْغُفْرَانِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
*قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ*
*وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ ۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ*
*وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ*
*وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَابَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ*
*مَّا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ*
*وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ*
*حسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ‏ وَأَمْتَنِعُ بِحَوْلِ اللَّهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ وَقُوَّتِهِمْ وَأَسْتَشْفِعُ‏ بِرَبِّ‏ الْفَلَقِ‏ مِنْ شَرِّ ما خَلَقَ‏ وَأَعُوذُ بِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّهَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.*
ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا
وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ
وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
entries.translation_en:
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and guide me, by Your permission, in that about which the truth is disputed; indeed, You guide whom You will to a straight path. (after 2:213)
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad — the successors who are content and well-pleasing — with Your finest blessings; bless them with Your finest benedictions; and peace be upon them, upon their spirits and their bodies; and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
O Allah, cause me to live upon that upon which You caused Ali ibn Abi Talib to live, and cause me to die upon that upon which Ali ibn Abi Talib died, peace be upon him.
I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance. I ask Allah for well-being. I seek Allah's protection from the Fire, and I ask Him for Paradise. I ask Allah for the wide-eyed companions (of Paradise).
There is no god but Allah, the King, the manifest Truth. May Allah bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; there is no god but Allah; Allah is Great; and there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty.
Whatever Allah wills comes to be; and there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty.
Glory be to Allah the Great, and praise be to Him; and there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty.
(Say ten times:) In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty. O Allah, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad over You: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad; place light in my sight, insight in my religion, certainty in my heart, sincerity in my deeds, safety in my soul, abundance in my provision, and gratitude to You forever, as long as You keep me alive.
O Lord of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and hasten the relief of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad. O my Lord, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, hasten the relief of the Household of Muhammad, and free my neck from the Fire. O Mighty One!
Glory be to Allah the Great, and praise be to Him; I seek Allah's forgiveness and I ask Him from His grace.
I have held fast to the firmest handhold of Allah, which never breaks, and I have taken refuge in the strong rope of Allah. I seek Allah's protection from the eruption of the Arabs and the non-Arabs, and I seek Allah's protection from the evil of the devils of mankind and jinn. I have relied upon Allah; I have sought my need from Allah. Allah suffices me, and He is the best trustee; there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. O Allah, my sins — even if they are a severance (from You) — I did not intend by them severance; and I do not say to You "the concession" (that I will never return), knowing my own frailty, nor do I complete repentance, knowing my weakness. I have come seeking Your pardon, and my means to You is Your nobility; so send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and honour me with Your forgiveness, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
I hold fast to the firmest handhold of Allah, which never breaks; I take refuge in the strong rope of Allah. I seek Allah's protection from the evil of the devils of mankind and jinn. I seek Allah's protection from the evil of the wicked among the Arabs and the non-Arabs. Allah suffices me. I have relied upon Allah. I have leaned my back upon Allah. I have sought my need from Allah. There is no power and no strength except by Allah.
O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, light in my tongue, light in my skin, light in my hair, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my bones, light in my nerves, light before me, light behind me, light on my right, light on my left, light above me, and light beneath me. O Allah, magnify my light.
(Then recite the closing verses of Surah Aal-e-Imran, 3:190-194 — in this app's Quran section.)
All praise belongs to Allah, who made me know Himself and did not leave me blind of heart. All praise belongs to Allah, who made me among the nation of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household. All praise belongs to Allah, who placed my provision in His own hands and did not place my provision in the hands of the people. All praise belongs to Allah, who concealed my sins and my faults and did not disgrace me among the creatures.
There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner to Him; to Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs the praise; He gives life and gives death; in His hand is all good; and He has power over all things.
(Protection dua of the morning:) I have entered the morning, O Allah, holding fast to Your invincible protection, which cannot be scaled and cannot be attempted, against the evil of every oppressor and every one who comes by night, among all that You have created and what You have created, of Your creation, the silent and the speaking — in a shield against everything feared, in a flowing garment: the allegiance of the Household of Your Prophet — veiled from everyone who intends me harm by an impregnable wall: sincerity in acknowledging their right and holding fast to their rope, certain that the truth belongs to them, is with them, is in them and is by them. I befriend whoever they befriend, and I shun whoever they shun. So protect me, O Allah, through them, from the evil of everything I fear, O Great One! I have restrained the enemies from me by the Originator of the heavens and the earth: "And We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and covered them, so they do not see." (36:9)
O Allah, set right for me my religion, which You have made my protection. O Allah, set right for me my worldly life, in which You have placed my livelihood. O Allah, set right for me my Hereafter, to which You have made my return. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your good pleasure from Your wrath, and I seek refuge in Your pardon from Your punishment. O Allah, I seek refuge in You: none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the might of the mighty does not benefit him against You.
O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and my sight, make them both my inheritors, and show me my vengeance upon my enemy.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and the domination of men, from the ruin of blessings, from heedlessness, abasement, hardness (of heart), poverty and destitution. I seek refuge in You from a soul that is never satisfied, from a heart that does not humble itself, from an eye that does not weep, from a supplication that is not heard, and from a prayer that does not benefit (is not raised). I seek refuge in You from a wife who turns me grey before the time of greying; I seek refuge in You from a child who becomes a master over me; I seek refuge in You from wealth that becomes a punishment upon me; and I seek refuge in You from a deceitful companion who, when he sees a good deed, buries it, and when he sees an evil deed, broadcasts it.
O Allah, do not appoint for any wicked person a hand (of favour) over me, nor an obligation.
(For the Imam of the Age:) O Allah, be for Your friend among Your creation a guardian, a protector, a leader and a helper, until You settle him in Your earth willingly, let him enjoy it for long, make him and his descendants in it the inheriting Imams, gather together his scattered (affairs), complete his matter for him, set right his subjects for him, firm up his foundation, pour patience from Yourself upon him until he takes vengeance — so that the burning grudges of rancorous hearts, the heat of angry breasts and the pangs of regret are cured...
(Then recite the verses of trust in Allah:) "...And whoever relies upon Allah — He is sufficient for him" ; "If Allah touches you with harm, none can remove it but He; and if He intends good for you, none can repel His grace; He strikes with it whom He wills of His servants, and He is the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful" (10:107); "There is no creature on earth but that its provision is upon Allah, and He knows its dwelling place and its repository; all is in a clear Book" (11:6); "And how many a creature does not carry its own provision — Allah provides for it and for you; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing" (29:60); "Whatever Allah opens of mercy for the people, none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds, none can release it after Him; and He is the Mighty, the Wise" (35:2); "And if you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely say: Allah. Say: Have you considered what you call upon besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, could they remove His harm? Or if He intended me mercy, could they withhold His mercy? Say: Allah suffices me; upon Him rely those who rely" (39:38); "Allah suffices me; there is no god but He; upon Him I rely, and He is Lord of the mighty Throne" (9:129). And I protect myself, by the power of Allah and His strength, from their power and their strength; and I seek intercession through the Lord of the Daybreak from the evil of what He created; and I seek protection in what Allah wills — there is no power except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty.
"And whoever is God-conscious, Allah appoints for him a way out, and provides for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah — He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah accomplishes His purpose; Allah has set a measure for all things." (65:2-3)
entries.note_en: Begin with the Common Ta'qibat (including Tasbihat al-Zahra), then these litanies specific to the Fajr prayer.

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مرة) — اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مرة) — سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٣٣ مرة)
لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ
لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمينَ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ
وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ
وَٱلْغَنيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ
وَٱلسَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ
اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
وَلاَ هَمّاً إِلاَّ فَرَّجْتَهُ
وَلاَ سُقْماً إِلاَّ شَفَيْتَهُ
وَلاَ عَيْباً إِلاَّ سَتَرْتَهُ
وَلاَ رِزْقاً إِلاَّ بَسَطْتَهُ
وَلاَ خَوْفاً إِلاَّ آمَنْتَهُ
وَلاَ سُوءاً إِلاَّ صَرَفْتَهُ
وَلاَ حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضاً وَلِيَ فيهَا صَلاَحٌ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَهَا
يَا أَرْحَمَ ٱلرَّاحِمينَ
آمينَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَالَمينَ
بِٱللَّهِ ٱعْتَصَمْتُ
وَبِٱللَّهِ أَثِقُ
وَعَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ أَتَوَكَّلُ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبِي فَأَنْتَ أَعْظَمُ
وَإِنْ كَبُرَ تَفْرِيطِي فَأَنْتَ أَكْبَرُ
وَإِنْ دَامَ بُخْلي فَأَنْتَ أَجْوَدُ
اَللَّهُمَّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي عَظيمَ ذُنُوبِي بِعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ
وَكَثيرَ تَفْرِيطِي بِظَاهِرِ كَرَمِكَ
وَٱقْمَعْ بُخْلِي بِفَضْلِ جُودِكَ
اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَة فَمِنْكَ
لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
اََللّهُمّ صَلّ عَلٰي مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ وَ عَجّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ.
اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ،
وَاَتَقرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ،
وَاَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِمَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبينَ وَاَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ وَعَلى آلِ مُحَمَّد،
وَاْنَ تُقيلَني عَثْرَتي وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي وَتَغْفِرَها لي،
وَتَقْضِيَ لي حَوائجي وَلا تُعَذِّبْني بِقَبيحٍ كانَ مِنّي،
فَاِنَّ عَفْوَكَ وَجُودَكَ يَسَعُني،
اِنَّكَ على كُلِّ شَيء قَديرٌ.
يا سامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ ،
يا جامِعَ (كُلِّ فَوْتٍ) ،
يا بارِئَ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ ،
يا باعِثُ ،
يا وارِثُ ،
يا سَيِّدَ السَّادَةِ ،
يا إِلهَ الْآلِهَةِ ،
يا جَبَّارَ الْجَبابِرَةِ ،
يا مَلِكَ الدُّنْيا وَالْآخِرَةِ ،
يا رَبَّ الْأَرْبابِ ،
يا مَلِكَ الْمُلُوكِ
يا بَطَّاشُ ، يا ذَا الْبَطْشِ الشَّديدِ ،
يا فَعَّالاً لِما يُريدُ ،
يا مُحْصِيَ عَدَدِ الْأَنْفاسِ وَنَقْلِ الْأَقْدامِ ،
يا مَنِ السِّرُّ عِنْدَهُ عَلانِيَةٌ ،
يا مُبْدِئُ ، يا مُعيدُ .
أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ عَلى خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
وَبِحَقِّهِمُ الَّذي أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ عَلى نَفْسِكَ ،
أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ ،
وَأَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ بِفِكاكِ رَقَبَتي مِنَ النَّارِ ،
وَأَنْجِزْ لِوَلِيِّكَ وَابْنِ نَبِيِّكَ الدَّاعي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ ،
وَأَمينِكَ في خَلْقِكَ ،
وَعَيْنِكَ في عِبادِكَ ،
وَحُجَّتِكَ عَلى خَلْقِكَ ،
عَلَيْهِ صَلَواتُكَ وَبَرَكاتُكَ وَعْدَهُ .
أَللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِنَصْرِكَ ،
وَانْصُرْ عَبْدَكَ ،
وَقَوِّ أَصْحابَهُ وَصَبِّرْهُمْ ،
وَاجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطاناً نَصيراً ،
وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُ ،
وَأَمْكِنْهُ مِنْ أَعْدائِكَ وَأَعْداءِ رَسُولِكَ ،
يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ .
entries.translation_en:
There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the noble Throne. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, I ask You for the things that bring about Your mercy, the resolutions of Your forgiveness, gain from every act of righteousness, and safety from every sin. O Allah, leave no sin of mine without forgiving it, no anxiety without relieving it, no sickness without curing it, no fault without concealing it, no provision without expanding it, no fear without giving security from it, no evil without turning it away, and no need — in which there is Your pleasure and my well-being — without fulfilling it. O Most Merciful of the merciful! Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
By Allah I have held fast; in Allah I trust; and upon Allah I rely.
O Allah, if my sins are great, You are greater; if my negligence is large, You are larger; and if my miserliness persists, You are more generous. O Allah, forgive my great sins by Your great pardon, my abundant negligence by Your manifest nobility, and suppress my miserliness by the abundance of Your generosity. O Allah, whatever blessing we have is from You; there is no god but You; I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and hasten their relief.
O Allah, I draw near to You through Your generosity and nobility; I draw near to You through Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger; and I draw near to You through Your near angels, Your prophets and Your messengers — that You send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger, and upon the Household of Muhammad; that You pardon my stumble, conceal my sins and forgive them for me; that You fulfil my needs and do not punish me for the ugliness that has come from me; for Your pardon and Your generosity encompass me. Indeed, You have power over all things.
O Hearer of every voice! O Gatherer of everything that passes away! O Creator of every soul after death! O Sender-forth! O Inheritor! O Master of masters! O God of gods! O Tyrant over tyrants! O King of this world and the Hereafter! O Lord of lords! O King of kings! O Seizer, Possessor of mighty seizing! O Doer of whatever He wills! O Counter of the number of breaths and the moving of feet! O He to whom the secret is as open! O Originator! O Restorer! I ask You, by Your right over the choicest of Your creation, and by their right which You have made obligatory for them upon Yourself: send blessings upon Muhammad and the People of his House, peace be upon him and upon them; and bestow upon me, this very hour, this very hour, the freeing of my neck from the Fire; and fulfil, for Your friend, the son of Your Prophet, the caller to You by Your permission, Your trustee among Your creation, Your eye among Your servants, and Your proof over Your creation — upon him be Your blessings and Your benedictions — his promise.
O Allah, aid him with Your help, support Your servant, strengthen his companions and make them patient, appoint for them, from Your presence, a helping authority, hasten his relief, and grant him power over Your enemies and the enemies of Your Messenger. O Most Merciful of the merciful!
entries.note_en: Begin with the Common Ta'qibat (including Tasbihat al-Zahra), then these litanies specific to the Dhuhr prayer.

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مرة) — اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مرة) — سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٣٣ مرة)
أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
ٱلْحَيُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
ٱلرَّحْمٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ذُو ٱلْجَلاَلِ وَٱلإِكْرَامِ
وَ أَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ
تَوْبَةَ عَبْدٍ ذَلِيلٍ خَاضِعٍ
فَقِيرٍ بَائِسٍ
مِسْكِينٍ مُسْتَكِينٍ مُسْتَجِيرٍ
لاَ يَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِهِ نَفْعَاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً
وَلاَ مَوْتاً وَلاَ حَيَاةً وَلاَ نُشُوراً
َللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ
وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ
وَمِنْ عِلْمٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ
وَمِنْ صَلاَةٍ لاَ تُرْفَعُ
وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لاَ يُسْمَعُ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ٱلْيُسْرَ بَعْدَ ٱلْعُسْرِ
وَٱلْفَرَجَ بَعْدَ ٱلْكَرْبِ
وَٱلرَّخَاءَ بَعْدَ ٱلشِّدَّةِ
اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
حَمْدًا لِلهِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْاَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
وَ رَبَّ جِبْرَآئِيْلَ وَ مِيْكَائِيْلَ وَ اِسْرَافِيْلَ وَ رَبَّ السَّبْعِ الْمَثَانِيْ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهٖ خَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْاَعْظَمِ الَّذِيْ بِهِ تَقُوْمُ السَّمٰوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ بِهٖ تُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰى وَ تَرْزُقُ الْاَحْيَا وَ تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْمُجْتَمَعِ بَيْنَ الْمُتَفَرِّقِ وَ بِهٖ اَحْصَيْتَ عَدَدَ الْآجَالِ وَ وَزْنَ الْجِبَالِ وَ كِيْلَ الْبِحَارِ
اَسْاَلُكَ يَا مَنْ هُوَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِيْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا.
اللهم إني أسألك الطيبات وترك المنكرات وفكاك خيرتي أن تغفر لنا وترحمنا وتتوب علينا وتوفنا غير مفتونين برحمتك يا أرحم الراحم
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
اَلْاَوَّلُ وَالْاٰخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُالْبَاطِنُ،
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
اِلَيْكَ زِيَادَةُ الْاَشْيَاۤءِ وَنُقْصَانُهَا،
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
خَلَقْتَ الْخَلْقَ بِغَيْرِ مَعُوْنَةٍ مِنْ غَيْرِكَ،
وَلَاحَاجَةٍ اِلَيْهِمْ،
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
مِنْكَ الْمَشِيَّةُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْبَدْءُ۔
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
قَبْلَ الْقَبْلِ وَخَالِقُ الْقَبْلِ،
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤاِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
بَعْدَ الْبَعْدِ وَخَالِقُ الْبَعْدِ،
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
تَمْحُوْ مَا تَشَاۤءُ وَتُثْبِتُ وَعِنْدَكَ اُمُّ الْكِتَابِ،
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ،
غَايَةُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَوَارِثُهُ،
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
لَايَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ الدَّقِيْقُ وَلَا الْجَلِيْلُ،
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
لَايَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ اللُّغَاتُ،
وَلَاتَتَشَابَهُ عَلَيْكَ الْاَصْوَاتُ۔
كُلَّ يَوْمٍ اَنْتَ فِيْ شَاْنٍ،
لَايَشْغَلُكَ شَاْنٌ عَنْ شَاْنٍ،
عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَاَخْفٰى،
دَيَّانُ الدِّيْنِ،
مُدَبِّرُ الْاُمُوْرِ،
بَاعِثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ،
مُحْيِ الْعِظَامِ وَهِيَ رَمِيْمٌ،
اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُوْنِ الْمَخْزُوْنِ،
اَلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ،
اَلَّذِيْ لَايَخِيْبُ مَنْ سَاَلَكَ بِهِ،
اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ،
وَاَنْ تُعَجِّلَ فَرَجَ الْمُنْتَقِمِ لَكَ مِنْ اَعْدَاۤئِكَ،
وَاَنْجِزْلَهُ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ،
يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ۔
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ والْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلا إلهَ إلاَّ اللهُ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ
وَلا حَوْلَ ولا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ باللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالإبْكَارِ فَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّموَاتِ والأَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عمَّا يَصِفُونَ
وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي العِزَّةِ والْجَبَرُوتِ سُبْحَان الحَيّ الَّذِي لا يَمُوتُ
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْقَائِمِ الدَّائِمِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ سُبْحَانَ الْعَلِيِّ الأَعْلى سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالى
سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلائِكَةِ والرُّوحِ.
اَللَّهُمَّ إنّ ذَنْبِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعَفَوِكَ وَخَوْفِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِأَمْنِكَ وَفَقْرِي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِغِنَاكَ وذُلّي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعِزّكَ،
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ واغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
اَللَّهُمَّ تَمَّ نُورُكَ فَهَدَيْتَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَعَظُمَ حِلْمُكَ فَعَفَوْتَ
فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَجْهُكَ رَبَّنَا أَكْرَمُ الْوُجُوهِ وَجَاهُكَ أَعْظَمُ الْجَاهِ وَعَطِيَّتُكَ أَفْضَلُ الْعَطَايَا تُطَاعُ
ربَّنَا وَتَشْكُرُ وَتُعْصى فَتَغْفِرُ وَتُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ وَتَكْشِفُ الضُّرَّ وَتُنْجِي مِنَ الْكَرْبِ وَتُغْني الْفُقِيرَ
وَتَشْفي السَّقِيمَ ولا يُجَاري آلاءَكَ أَحَدٌ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
يَا مَنْ خَتَمَ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
إِخْتِمْ لِي فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
وَشَهْرِي بِخَيْرٍ
وَسَنَتِي بِخَيْرٍ
وَعُمْرِي بِخَيْرٍ
اللَّهُمَّ دَعَوْتَنِي فَاجَبْتُ دَعْوَتَكَ
وَصَلَّيْتُ مَكْتُوبَتَكَ
وَٱنْتَشَرْتُ فِي ارْضِكَ كَمَا امَرْتَنِي
فَاسْالُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ٱلْعَمَلَ بِطَاعَتِكَ
وَٱجْتِنَابَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
وَٱلْكَفَافَ مِنَ ٱلرِّزْقِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ
وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيراً
entries.translation_en:
I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful, the Possessor of Majesty and Honour; and I ask Him to accept my repentance — the repentance of a servant who is abased, submissive, poor, wretched, destitute, lowly and seeking protection, who owns for himself neither benefit nor harm, neither death nor life nor resurrection.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a soul that is never satisfied, from a heart that does not humble itself, from knowledge that does not benefit, from a prayer that is not raised, and from a supplication that is not heard.
O Allah, I ask You for ease after hardship, relief after distress, and prosperity after adversity.
O Allah, whatever blessing we have is from You; there is no god but You; I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance. (Say: All praise belongs to Allah.)
O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths, what is in them, what is between them and what is beneath them; Lord of the mighty Throne; Lord of Gabriel, Michael and Israfil; Lord of the Seven Oft-Repeated Verses and the mighty Qur'an; and Lord of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, the Seal of the Prophets: I ask You by Your greatest Name, by which the heavens and the earth stand, by which You revive the dead and provide for the living, by which You gather what is scattered and separate what is joined, and by which You have counted the number of terms of life, the weight of the mountains and the measure of the seas — I ask You, O He who is such: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and do for me (here the supplicant mentions his need).
O Allah, I ask You for the good things, for abandoning the forbidden things, and for release (from the Fire); that You forgive us, have mercy on us, turn to us in repentance, and take us (in death) untempted — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
You are Allah; there is no god but You — the First, the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden. And You are Allah; there is no god but You — to You belongs the increase of things and their decrease. And You are Allah; there is no god but You — You created creation without help from anyone other than You, and without need of them. You are Allah; there is no god but You — from You is the will, and to You is the beginning. You are Allah; there is no god but You — before the "before", and Creator of the "before". You are Allah; there is no god but You — after the "after", and Creator of the "after". You are Allah; there is no god but You — You erase what You will and You confirm, and with You is the Mother of the Book. You are Allah; there is no god but You — the end of everything and its inheritor. You are Allah; there is no god but You — neither the subtle nor the gross escapes You. You are Allah; there is no god but You — the languages are not hidden from You, and the voices do not become confused for You. Every day You are upon some affair; no affair distracts You from another affair. Knower of the unseen and what is more hidden; Judge of the religion; Disposer of the affairs; Resurrector of those in the graves; Reviver of bones when they have decayed. I ask You by Your hidden, stored Name, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, by which whoever asks You is not disappointed: send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household, and hasten the relief of the one who will exact vengeance for You from Your enemies, and fulfil for him what You promised him. O Possessor of Majesty and Honour!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. Glory be to Allah, all praise belongs to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is Great, and there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty. Glory be to Allah at morning and evening; glory be to Allah in the evening and at dawn. "So glory be to Allah when you enter the evening and when you enter the morning; and to Him belongs the praise in the heavens and the earth, and at nightfall and when you are at noon" (30:17-18). "Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe; and peace be upon the messengers; and all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds" (37:180-182). Glory be to the Possessor of the kingdom and the dominion; glory be to the Possessor of might and irresistible power; glory be to the Living who does not die; glory be to Allah, the Established, the Everlasting; glory be to Allah, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting; glory be to the Most High, the All-High — glory be to Him and exalted is He. All-Glorious, All-Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
O Allah, my sin has come into the evening seeking refuge in Your pardon; my fear has come into the evening seeking refuge in Your security; my poverty has come into the evening seeking refuge in Your richness; and my abasement has come into the evening seeking refuge in Your might. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, forgive me and have mercy on me; indeed, You are All-Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.
O Allah, Your light has been completed and You have guided — so to You belongs the praise; Your forbearance has grown great and You have pardoned — so to You belongs the praise. Your Face, our Lord, is the noblest of faces; Your standing is the greatest standing; and Your gift is the finest of gifts. You are obeyed, our Lord, and You thank; You are disobeyed, and You forgive; You answer the compelled one; You remove harm; You rescue from distress; You enrich the poor; You cure the sick; and no one can rival Your blessings. And You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
(After the prayer:) O He who sealed prophethood with Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household: seal for me this day of mine with good, my month with good, my year with good, and my life with good.
O Allah, You called me and I answered Your call; I prayed Your prescribed prayer; and I have spread out in Your earth as You commanded me. So I ask You, from Your grace: work in obedience to You, avoidance of disobedience to You, and sufficiency of provision — by Your mercy.
Glory be to Allah; there is no god but Allah; and all praise belongs to Allah, who has not taken a consort or a child, has no partner in the kingdom, and has no protector out of lowliness — and magnify Him with all magnification. (17:111)
entries.note_en: Begin with the Common Ta'qibat (including Tasbihat al-Zahra), then these litanies specific to the Asr prayer. Where the text says 'do for me such-and-such', mention your own need.

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مرة) — اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مرة) — سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٣٣ مرة)
﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلاَئِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّون عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّبِيِّ
يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذينَ آمَنُوٱ صَلُّوٱ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوٱ تَسْليماً﴾
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّد ٱلنَّبِيِّ
وَعَلَىٰ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ
وَعَلَىٰ أَهلِ بَيْتِهِ
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظيِمِ
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذي يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ
وَلاَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ غَيْرُهُ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ
وَعَزَائِمِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ
وَٱلنَّجَاةَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
وَمِنْ كُلِّ بِلِيَّةٍ
وَٱلْفَوْزَ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ
وَٱلرِّضْوَانِ في دَارِ ٱلسَّلاَمِ
وَجَوَارِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
سُبْحَانَكَ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
إِغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي كُلَّهَا جَمِيعاً
فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ كُلَّهَا جَمِيعاً إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ بِإِقْبَالِ لَيْلِكَ
وَإِدْبَارِ نَهَارِكَ
وَحُضُورِ صَلَوَاتِكَ
وَاصْوَاتِ دُعَاتِكَ
وَتَسْبِيحِ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ
انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
وَانْ تَتُوْبَ عَلَيَّ
إِنَّكَ انْتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ ‎﴿١٧﴾‏ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ ‎﴿١٨﴾
اَللّٰهُمَّ أَجِرْنَا مِنَ النَّارِ سَالِمِيْنَ وَ أَدْخِلْنَا الْجَنَّةَبِسَلَامٍ آمِنِيْنَ وَ تَوَفَّنا مُسْلِمِيْنَ‏ وَ أَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِيْنَ‏بِفَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ مُقَلِّبَ‏ الْقُلُوْبِ‏ وَ الْأَبْصَارِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلىٰ دِيْنِكَ
وَ لَا تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي وَ هَبْ لِي‏ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ‏
وَ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
اَللّٰهُمَّ امْدُدْ لِيْ فِيْ عُمُرِي وَ اَوْسِعْ عَليَّ فِيْ رِزْقِيْ وَانْشُرْ عَلَيَّ رَحْمَتَكَ
وَ إِنْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَكَ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ شَقِيًّا
فَاجْعَلْنِي سَعِيْدًا فَإِنَّكَ تَمْحُوْ مَا تَشَاءُ وَ تُثْبِتُ وَ عِنْدَكَ أُمُّ الْكِتَاب‏ِ.
عشرة استعاذات
قال أبو عبد الله (عليه السَّلامُ): إذا أمسيت وأصبحت فقُلْ دُبُر الفريضة في صلاة المغرب وصلاة الفجر (عشر مرات):
أَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
اكْتُبَا رَحِمَكُمَا اللَّهُ
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرّحمنِ الرَّحِيمِ أَمْسَيْتُ وَ أَصْبَحْتُ بِاللَّهِ مُؤْمِناً عَلَى دِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلّى اللهُ عليه وآله) وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ عَلَى دِينِ عَلِيٍّ (عليه السَّلامُ) وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ عَلَى دِينِ فَاطِمَةَ (عليها السَّلامُ)
وَ سُنَّتِهَا وَ عَلَى دِينِ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ صَلَواتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسُنَّتِهِمْ
آمَنْتُ بِسِرِّهِمْ وَعَلَانِيَتِهِمْ وَبِغَيْبِهِمْ وَشَهَادَتِهِمْ
وَأَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ فِي لَيْلَتِي
هَذِهِ وَيَوْمِي هَذَا مِمَّا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَعَلِيٌّ وَفَاطِمَةُ وَالْأَوْصِيَاءُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِمْ
وَأَرْغَبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ فِيمَا رَغِبُوا فِيهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كُلَّمَا وَقَبَ لَيْلٌ وَغَسَقَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كُلَّمَا لَاحَ نَجْمٌ وَخَفَقَ.
دعاء للدنيا والآخرة ولوجع العين
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْ تَجْعَلِ النُّورَ فِي بَصَرِي وَالْبَصِيرَةَ فِي دِينِي وَالْيَقِينَ فِي قَلْبِي وَالْإِخْلَاصَ فِي عَمَلِي وَالسَّلَامَةَ فِي نَفْسِي وَالسَّعَةَ فِي رِزْقِي وَالشُّكْرَ لَكَ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي.
فضله دعاء للدنيا والآخرة ويكفى به وجع العين عن الدعاء
عن محمّد الجعفيّ عن أبيه قال: كنت كثيراً ما أشتكي عيني فشكوت ذلك إلى أبي عبد الله (عليه السَّلامُ) فقال: ألا أعلمك دعاءً لدنياك وآخرتك وتكفى به وجع عينك؟ فقلت: بلى فقال: تقول هذا الدعاء في دُبُر الفجر ودُبُر المغرب
دعاء للضمان من السرقة
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِقُدْرَةِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِمَغْفِرَةِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِسُلْطَانِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
وَأَعُوذُ بِكَرَمِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِجَمْعِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ وَشَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ
وَكُلِّ مُغْتَالٍ وَسَارِقٍ وَعَارِضٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ والْعَامَّةِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ أَوْ كَبِيرَةٍ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ فُسَّاقِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ وَ فُجَّارِهِمْ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ رَبِّي آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
عن أبي جعفر أو أبي عبد الله (عليهما السَّلامُ) قال: كلُّ من قال هذه الكلمات واستعمل هذه العوذة في كلّ ليلة ضمنت له ألاّ يغتاله مغتال من سارق في الليل والنهار يقول بعد صلاة العشاء الآخرة
دعاء الإمام الحسين
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ
أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِي
وَمَالِي بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ
وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ وهي العوذة الَّتِي عَوَّذَ بِهَا جَبْرَائِيلُ الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ (عليهما السَّلامُ).
عن الدعاء
قال أبو عبد الله (عليه السَّلامُ): حصّنوا أموالكم وأهليكم وأحرزوهم بهذه الدعاء وقولوها بعد صلاة العشاء الآخرة
يَا شَدِيدَ الْمَحَالِ يَا عَزِيزاً ذَلَّلْتَ بِعِزَّتِكَ جَمِيعَ مَا خَلَقْتَ اكْفِنِي شَرَّ (فُلانٍ بِمَا شِئْتَ).
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَبْلُغُ مَدْحَتَهُ الْقَائِلُوْنَ، وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُحْصِيْ نَعْمَاءَهُ الْعَادُّوْنَ، وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُؤَدِّيْ حَقَّهُ الْمُجْتَهِدُوْنَ، وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْاَوَّلُ وَ الْاٰخِرُ، وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الظَّاهِرُ وَ الْبَاطِنُ، وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْمُحْيِيْ الْمُمِيْتُ، وَ اللهُ اَكْبَرُ ذُوْ الطَّوْلِ وَ اللهُ اَكْبَرُ ذُوْ الْبَقَاءِ الدَّائِمِ.
وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُدْرِكُ الْعَالِمُوْنَ عِلْمَهٗ، وَ لَا يَسْتَخِفُّ الْجَاهِلُوْنَ حِلْمَهٗ، وَ لَا يَبْلُغُ الْمَادِحُوْنَ مِدْحَتَهٗ، وَ لَا يَصِفُ الْوَاصِفُوْنَ صِفَتَهٗ وَ لَا يُحْسِنُ الْخَلْقُ نَعْتَهٗ.
وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ ذِيْ الْمُلْكِ وَ الْمَلَكُوْتِ، وَ الْعَظَمَةِ وَ الْجَبَرُوْتِ (وَ الْعِزِّ) وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَ الْبَهَاءِ وَ الْجَلَالِ، وَ الْمَهَابَةِ وَ الْجَمَالِ، وَ الْعِزَّةِ وَ الْقُدْرَةِ وَ الْحَوْلِ وَ الْقُوَّةِ، وَ الْمِنَّةِ وَ الْغَلَبَةِ، وَ الْفَضْلِ وَ الطَّوْلِ، وَ الْعَدْلِ وَ الْحَقِّ وَ الْخَلْقِ وَ الْعَلَاءِ، وَ الرِّفْعَةِ وَ الْمَجْدِ، وَ الْفَضِيْلَةِ وَ الْحِكْمَةِ وَ الْغِنَاءِ وَ السَّعَةِ وَ الْبَسْطِ وَ الْقَبْضِ، وَ الْحِلْمِ وَ الْعِلْمِ، وَ الْحُجَّةِ الْبَالِغَةِ وَ النِّعْمَةِ السَّابِغَةِ وَ الثَّنَاءِ الْحَسَنِ الْجَمِيْلِ وَ الْاٰلَاءِ الْكَرِيْمَةِ، مَلِكِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ النَّارِ، وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ تَبَارَكَ (اللهُ) وَ تَعَالٰى.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ عَلِمَ اَسْرَارَ الْغُيُوْبِ، وَ اطَّلَعَ عَلٰى مَا تَجِنُّ الْقُلُوْبُ فَلَيْسَ عَنْهُ مَذْهَبٌ وَ لَا مَهْرَبٌ، وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِ فِيْ سُلْطَانِهِ الْعَزِيْزِ فِيْ مَكَانِهِ، الْمُتَجَبِّرِ فِيْ مُلْكِهِ، الْقَوِيِّ فِيْ بَطْشِهِ، الرَّفِيْعِ فَوْقَ عَرْشِهِ، الْمُطَّلِعِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهٖ، وَ الْبَالِغِ لِمَا اَرَادَ مِنْ عِلْمِهٖ.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ بِكَلِمَاتِهٖ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ الشِّدَادُ، وَ ثَبَتَتِ الْاَرَضُوْنَ الْمِهَادُ، وَ انْتَصَبَتِ الْجِبَالُ الرَّوَاسِيْ الْاَوْتَادُ، وَ جَرَتِ الرِّيَاحُ اللَّوَاقِحُ، وَ سَارَ فِيْ جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ السَّحَابُ، وَ وَقَفَتْ عَلٰى حُدُوْدِهَا الْبِحَارُ، وَ وَجِلَتِ الْقُلُوْبُ مِنْ مَخَافَتِهٖ، وَ انْقَمَعَتِ الْاَرْبَابُ لِرُبُوْبِيَّتِهٖ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا مُحْصِيْ قَطْرِ الْمَطَرِ، وَ وَرَقِ الشَّجَرِ، وَ مُحْيِيْ اَجْسَادِ الْمَوْتٰى لِلْحَشْرِ.
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ، مَا فَعَلْتَ بِالْغَرِيْبِ الْفَقِيْرِ اِذَا اَتَاكَ مُسْتَجِيْرًا مُسْتَغِيْثًا؟ مَا فَعَلْتَ بِمَنْ اَنَاخَ بِفِنَائِكَ وَ تَعَرَّضَ لِرِضَاكَ وَ غَدَا اِلَيْكَ، فَجَثَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، يَشْكُوْ اِلَيْكَ مَا لَا يَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ؟ فَلَا يَكُوْنَنَّ يَا رَبِّ حَظِّيْ مِنْ دُعَائِيْ الْحِرْمَانُ، وَ لَا نَصِيْبِيْ مِمَّا اَرْجُوْ مِنْكَ الْخِذْلَانُ.
يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَزَلْ وَ لَا يَزُوْلُ كَمَا لَمْ يَزَلْ قَائِمًا عَلٰى كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
يَا مَنْ جَعَلَ اَيَّامَ الدُّنْيَا تَزُوْلُ، وَ شُهُوْرَهَا تَحُوْلُ، وَ سِنِيَّهَا تَدُوْرُ.
وَ اَنْتَ الدَّائِمُ لَا تُبْلِيْكَ الْاَزْمَانُ، وَ لَا تُغَيِّرُكَ الدُّهُوْرُ.
يَا مَنْ كُلُّ يَوْمٍ عِنْدَهٗ جَدِيْدٌ، وَ كُلُّ رِزْقٍ عِنْدَهٗ عَتِيْدٌ، لِلضَّعِيْفِ وَ الْقَوِيِّ وَ الشَّدِيْدِ، قَسَّمْتَ الْاَرْزَاقَ بَيْنَ الْخَلَائِقِ، فَسَوَّيْتَ بَيْنَ الذَّرَّةِ وَ الْعُصْفُوْرِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا ضَاقَ الْمُقَامُ بِالنَّاسِ، فَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيْقِ الْمُقَامِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا طَالَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ، فَقَصِّرْ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْنَا كَمَا بَيْنَ الصَّلَاةِ اِلَى الصَّلَاةِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا اَدْنَيْتَ الشَّمْسَ مِنَ الْجَمَاجِمِ، فَكَانَ بَيْنَهَا وَ بَيْنَ الْجَمَاجِمِ مِقْدَارُ مِيْلٍ، وَ زِيْدَ فِيْ حَرِّهَا حَرَّ عَشْرِ سِنِيْنَ، فَاِنَّا نَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُظِلَّنَا بِالْغَمَامِ، وَ تَنْصِبَ لَنَا الْمَنَابِرَ وَ الْكَرَاسِيَّ نَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهَا وَ النَّاسُ يَنْطَلِقُوْنَ فِيْ الْمُقَامِ، اٰمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
اَسْاَلُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ هٰذِهِ الْمَحَامِدِ، اِلَّا غَفَرْتَ لِيْ وَ تَجَاوَزْتَ عَنِّيْ وَ اَلْبَسْتَنِيْ الْعَافِيَةَ فِيْ بَدَنِيْ، وَ رَزَقْتَنِيْ السَّلَامَةَ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ.
فَاِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ، وَ اَنَا وَاثِقٌ بِاِجَابَتِكَ اِيَّايَ فِيْ مَسْاَلَتِيْ، وَ اَدْعُوْكَ وَ اَنَا عَالِمٌ بِاسْتِمَاعِكَ دَعْوَتِيْ، فَاسْتَمِعْ دُعَائِيْ، وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِيْ، وَ لَا تَرُدَّ ثَنَائِيْ وَ لَا تُخَيِّبْ دُعَائِيْ، اَنَا مُحْتَاجٌ اِلٰى رِضْوَانِكَ، وَ فَقِيْرٌ اِلٰى غُفْرَانِكَ وَ اَسْاَلُكَ وَ لَا اٰيِسٌ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَ اَدْعُوْكَ وَ اَنَا غَيْرُ مُحْتَرِزٍ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ.
رَبِّ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِيْ، وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِعَفْوِكَ، وَ تَوَفَّنِيْ مُسْلِمًا، وَ اَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصَّالِحِيْنَ،
رَبِّ لَا تَمْنَعْنِيْ فَضْلَكَ يَا مَنَّانُ، وَ لَا تَكِلْنِيْ اِلٰى نَفْسِيْ مَخْذُوْلًا، يَا حَنَّانُ.
رَبِّ ارْحَمْ عِنْدَ فِرَاقِ الْاَحِبَّةِ صَرْعَتِيْ، وَ عِنْدَ سُكُوْنِ الْقَبْرِ وَحْدَتِيْ وَ فِيْ مَفَازَةِ الْقِيَامَةِ غُرْبَتِيْ، وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ مَوْقُوْفًا لِلْحِسَابِ فَاقَتِيْ.
رَبِّ اَسْتَجِيْرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ فَاَجِرْنِيْ، رَبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ فَاَعِذْنِيْ (رَبِّ) اَفْزَعُ اِلَيْكَ مِنَ النَّارِ فَاَبْعِدْنِيْ، رَبِّ اَسْتَرْحِمُكَ مَكْرُوْبًا فَارْحَمْنِيْ.
رَبِّ اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا جَهِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي، (رَبِّ) قَدْ اَبْرَزَنِيْ الدُّعَاءُ لِلْحَاجَةِ اِلَيْكَ فَلَا تُؤْيِسْنِيْ، يَا كَرِيْمُ ذَا الْاٰلَاءِ وَ الْاِحْسَانِ وَ التَّجَاوُزِ.
سَيِّدِيْ يَا بَرُّ يَا رَحِيْمُ، اِسْتَجِبْ بَيْنَ الْمُتَضَرِّعِيْنَ اِلَيْكَ دَعْوَتِيْ وَ ارْحَمْ بَيْنَ الْمُنْتَحِبِيْنَ بِالْعَوِيْلِ عَبْرَتِيْ، وَ اجْعَلْ فِيْ لِقَائِكَ يَوْمَ الْخُرُوْجِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا رَاحَتِيْ، وَ اسْتُرْ بَيْنَ الْاَمْوَاتِ يَا عَظِيْمَ الرَّجَاءِ عَوْرَتِيْ، وَ اعْطِفْ عَلَيَّ عِنْدَ التَّحَوُّلِ وَحِيْدًا اِلٰى حُفْرَتِيْ، اِنَّكَ اَمَلِيْ وَ مَوْضِعُ طَلِبَتِيْ، وَ الْعَارِفُ بِمَا اُرِيْدُ فِيْ تَوْجِيْهِ مَسْاَلَتِيْ.
فَاقْضِ يَا قَاضِيَ الْحَاجَاتِ حَاجَتِيْ، فَاِلَيْكَ الْمُشْتَكٰى وَ اَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَ الْمُرْتَجٰى، اَفِرُّ اِلَيْكَ هَارِبًا مِنَ الذُّنُوْبِ فَاقْبَلْنِيْ، وَ اَلْتَجِأُ مِنْ عَدْلِكَ اِلٰى مَغْفِرَتِكَ فَاَدْرِكْنِيْ، وَ اَلْتَاذُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ بَطْشِكَ فَامْنَعْنِيْ وَ اَسْتَرْوِحُ رَحْمَتَكَ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ فَنَجِّنِيْ، وَ اَطْلُبُ الْقُرْبَةَ مِنْكَ بِالْاِسْلَامِ فَقَرِّبْنِيْ، وَ مِنَ الْفَزَعِ الْاَكْبَرِ فَاٰمِنِّيْ، وَ فِيْ ظِلِّ عَرْشِكَ فَظَلِّلْنِيْ، وَ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ فَهَبْ لِيْ، وَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا سَالِمًا فَنَجِّنِيْ، وَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ اِلَى النُّوْرِ فَاَخْرِجْنِيْ.
وَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَبَيِّضْ وَجْهِيْ، وَ حِسَابًا يَسِيْرًا فَحَاسِبْنِيْ وَ بِسَرَائِرِيْ فَلَا تَفْضَحْنِيْ، وَ عَلٰى بَلَائِكَ فَصَبِّرْنِيْ، وَ كَمَا صَرَفْتَ عَنْ يُوْسُفَ السُّوْءَ وَ الْفَحْشَاءَ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّيْ، وَ مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِيْ بِهٖ فَلَا تُحَمِّلْنِيْ.
وَ اِلٰى دَارِ السَّلَامِ فَاهْدِنِيْ، وَ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ فَانْفَعْنِيْ، وَ بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فَثَبِّتْنِيْ، وَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ فَاحْفَظْنِيْ، وَ بِحَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ وَ جَبَرُوْتِكَ فَاعْصِمْنِيْ، وَ بِحِلْمِكَ وَ عِلْمِكَ وَ سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ فَنَجِّنِيْ، وَ جَنَّتَكَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ فَاَسْكِنِّيْ، وَ النَّظَرَ اِلٰى وَجْهِكَ فَارْزُقْنِيْ، وَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاَلْحِقْنِيْ، وَ مِنَ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَ اَوْلِيَائِهِمْ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِيْ شَرٍّ فَاكْفِنِيْ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ اَعْدَائِيْ وَ مَنْ كَادَنِيْ بِسُوْءٍ اِنْ اَتَوْا بَرًّا فَجَبِّنْ شَجِيْعَهُمْ، فَضِّ جُمُوْعَهُمْ، كَلِّلْ سِلَاحَهُمْ، عَرْقِبْ دَوَابَّهُمْ، سَلِّطْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَوَاصِفَ وَ الْقَوَاصِفَ اَبَدًا حَتّٰى تُصْلِيْهِمُ النَّارَ، اَنْزِلْهُمْ مِنْ صَيَاصِيْهِمْ، وَ اَمْكِنَّا مِنْ نَوَاصِيْهِمْ اٰمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، صَلَاةً يَشْهَدُ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ مَعَ الْاَبْرَارِ وَ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ، وَ قَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ، وَ مِفْتَاحِ الرَّحْمَةِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ، وَ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ، وَ رَبَّ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَ رَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَ الْمَقَامِ، وَ رَبَّ الْحِلِّ وَ الْحَرَامِ، بَلِّغْ رُوْحَ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنَّا التَّحِيَّةَ وَ السَّلَامَ.
اَلسَّلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ، سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَمِيْنَ اللهِ، سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللهِ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهٗ.
فَهُوَ كَمَا وَصَفْتَهٗ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رَءُوْفٌ رَحِيْمٌ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِهٖ اَفْضَلَ مَا سَاَلَكَ، وَ اَفْضَلَ مَا سُئِلْتَ لَهٗ، وَ اَفْضَلَ مَا اَنْتَ مَسْئُوْلٌ لَهٗ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، اٰمِيْنَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.‏ ‏
